allOf.$comment: qfix2-2026-08-26, additive relaxation: `call` is OPTIONAL when the finding is a `definition_change` — that kind is evidenced by two published tools/list snapshots and has `source_call_id: null` by nature, so no call exists to send. Every other kind still REQUIRES `call` (a call-less `output_mismatch` / `type-mismatch` is refused with 400 finding_has_no_call). Every payload valid before this change is still valid.

invitee_email.description: DEPRECATED (v0.1a): optional and ignored — the CP sends no invite email; the consumer copies the thread link.

evidence_origin.description: OPTIONAL, additive (slice2-2026-08-28): how the evidence call was chosen. Absent means "finding" — the flag came off a finding row, so the promoted call's bodies start WITHHELD from the provider. "call_pick" — the operator chose the call while looking at it, so it starts revealed. The CP reads unknown values as "finding" (tolerant).

call.description: The redacted evidence call. REQUIRED for every finding kind except `definition_change`, which is call-less by nature (qfix2-2026-08-26).
